observations: Three photos show a used car engine in a cluttered, dimly lit space, likely a workshop or storage area.
The engine has visible components: belts, pulleys, hoses, intake manifold, and a black plastic cover with a white 'K' logo.
The engine appears dirty and worn, with signs of use and possible corrosion.
The white 'K' logo on the black cover is consistent across all three photos, suggesting it is a key identifier.
No visible model number, VIN, or engine code is readable on any part of the engine.
The seller's text mentions 'all kinds of cars spare parts' but does not specify the engine's make or model.
